newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INTERIOR MINISTER REMOVED FROM POST.
newsitem.headline: INTERIOR MINISTER REMOVED FROM POST.

text.p: Prime Minister Mart Siimann has proposed that Interior Minister Riivo Sinijarv be released from service, the Estonian news agency ETA said on Tuesday.
The proposal was made to President Lennart Meri and it was suggested that Sinijarv re-enter the diplomatic service, ETA said, quoting the prime minister's press office.
Siimann's spokesman was not immediately available to confirm the report but the Baltic News Service (BNS) quoted the spokesman as saying that Siinijarv left the minister's job of his own accord.

Sinijarv, a member of Siimann's Coalition Party, became interior minister on March 17. He previously served as foreign minister and minister without portfolio for European Affairs in the governments of former premier Tiit Vaehi.
